description: This Java source file defines the enum DepositAccountOnClosureType, which specifies various options for closing deposit accounts such as withdrawal, transfer, and reinvestment procedures.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnClosureType
classes.description: An enumeration of different options available on account closure for deposit accounts, including associated codes and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the closure type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the closure type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding DepositAccountOnClosureType enum value, defaulting to INVALID.

methods.name: isWithdarwDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is WITHDRAW_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isTransferToSavings
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is TRANSFER_TO_SAVINGS.

methods.name: isReinvest
methods.description: Checks if the closure type involves reinvesting (principal and interest or principal only).

methods.name: isReinvestPrincipal
methods.description: Checks if the closure type involves reinvesting only the principal.

methods.name: isReinvestPrincipalAndInterest
methods.description: Checks if the closure type involves reinvesting principal and interest.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is INVALID.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer codes for all valid closure types (excluding INVALID).
